round: relevance-filtering research round 8 (zukhruf #3195): the truncated fit with ordered components
writtenBefore: any round-8 score. Round 7 (round-7/plan.json) was read: 'truncated' passed poolA and poolB but failed the window protocol (lower bound -0.061 vs keywordNarrow); post hoc, the likelihood had a second peak with mu1 <= mu0 that the single start reached, and the Platt fallback then accepted almost every article (regulation fresh-2 N=10: 1,446 of about 1,500).
why: A two-component mixture is identifiable only up to label order; the standard remedy is an ordering constraint on the component means (McLachlan & Peel 2000, Finite Mixture Models, section 2.5), here built into the parameters so that mu1 <= mu0 cannot be represented. Several starts and keeping the highest likelihood is the standard guard against local optima in mixture fitting.
